tools.name: ausha_list_shows
tools.description: List the podcast shows this token can access: the shows the account owns and the shows shared with it. Start here to find a show id. Ausha API: GET /v1/shows/granted (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_get_show
tools.description: Get one show by its numeric id. Ausha API: GET /v1/shows/{show} (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_get_show_by_public_id
tools.description: Get one show by its public id (the id in its public URL). Ausha API: GET /v1/shows/public_id/{showByPublicId} (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_list_seasons
tools.description: List the seasons of a show, with the podcast count per season. Ausha API: GET /v1/shows/{show}/seasons (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_get_season
tools.description: Get one season by its numeric id. Ausha API: GET /v1/seasons/{season} (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the ad campaigns of a show (name, type, state, dates, listen limits). Ausha API: GET /v1/shows/{show}/campaigns (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one ad campaign by its numeric id. Ausha API: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaign} (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_list_podcasts
tools.description: List the episodes of a show. Filter by title keyword, season ids, or status (active, draft, scheduled). Ausha API: GET /v1/shows/{show}/podcasts (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_get_podcast
tools.description: Get one episode (podcast) by its numeric id. Ausha API: GET /v1/podcasts/{podcast} (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_get_podcast_by_public_id
tools.description: Get one episode by its public id (the id in its public URL). Ausha API: GET /v1/podcasts/public_id/{podcastByPublicId} (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_list_playlists
tools.description: List the playlists of a show with their privacy and episode count. Ausha API: GET /v1/shows/{show}/playlists (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_get_playlist
tools.description: Get one playlist by its numeric id, with its episodes in order. Ausha API: GET /v1/playlists/{playlist} (Viewer).

tools.name: ausha_create_playlist
tools.description: Create a playlist in a show. A private playlist needs a password. Creates data, so it is marked as a write. Ausha API: POST /v1/shows/{show}/playlists (Editor).

tools.name: ausha_update_playlist
tools.description: Change a playlist's name, privacy, password, slug or description. Fields you omit stay as they are. Ausha API: PUT /v1/playlists/{playlist} (Editor).

tools.name: ausha_add_podcast_to_playlist
tools.description: Add one episode to a playlist. The episode must belong to the same show (otherwise HTTP 422). Ausha API: POST /v1/playlists/{playlist}/podcasts/{podcast} (Editor).

tools.name: ausha_move_podcast_in_playlist
tools.description: Change the position of an episode inside a playlist. playlist_podcast_id is the id of the playlist-episode relation, not the episode id. Ausha API: PUT /v1/playlists/{playlist}/podcasts/{playlistPodcast} (Editor).

tools.name: ausha_remove_podcast_from_playlist
tools.description: Remove one episode from a playlist. playlist_podcast_id is the id of the playlist-episode relation, not the episode id. The episode itself is kept. Ausha API: DELETE /v1/playlists/{playlist}/podcasts/{playlistPodcast} (Editor).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ausha_create_playlist" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ausha_get_show_by_public_id, ausha_get_podcast_by_public_id · Private data: ausha_list_shows, ausha_create_playlist, ausha_update_playlist · Public sink: ausha_create_playlist, ausha_add_podcast_to_playlist · Destructive: ausha_remove_podcast_from_playlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ausha_get_show_by_public_id, ausha_get_podcast_by_public_id · Private data: ausha_list_shows, ausha_create_playlist, ausha_update_playlist · Public sink: ausha_create_playlist, ausha_add_podcast_to_playlist · Destructive: ausha_remove_podcast_from_playlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
